info.title: ShogunAgent Agent API
info.summary: The REST face of the state layer for AI agents: registration, wallet, quotes, receipts, the metered MCP proxy, the router verbs and the agent-readable documents.
info.description: The state layer for AI agents. Read what is true about the user's work right now (people, projects, commitments, open loops) with a quote and a confidence score on every fact; write what you learned so the next agent starts from it; run tools through a router that enforces permission tiers. Not a transcript store and not a general web-search tool.
info.x-pending: The core's /v1/state/*, /v1/memory/*, /v1/actions/* and /v1/export routes join this document when E4 exports rest_routing.rs (docs/api/tool-table.json.md).

post.description: Assembled by the core (handoff.create; the gateway relays the body and the answer untouched): one recall of the task, mapped onto people, projects, commitments and open loops with their confidence band and provenance quotes; Low never travels. get.description: Sequence: key (401 with WWW-Authenticate first) → classify → quote → reserve → relay to the principal's core as a stream → settle once from the core's reply Mcp-Quantity (capped at the reservation; 0 for a JSON-RPC error, a refusal, an idempotent replay, a non-2xx or a reply without it; reads are always 0). Tool names today: memory.search, memory.get_context, memory.get_context_pack, memory.get_events, memory.read_session, memory.get_wrap, memory.get_periods, memory.recall, calendar.upcoming, profile.whoami, state.commitments.list, state.open_loops.list, state.people.list, state.projects.list, state.people.get, state.projects.get, wiki.evidence, actions.status, memory.append_note, memory.ingest, actions.execute. Annotations per tool are in the server card (https://api.test/.well-known/mcp/server-card.json).

post.summary: Find tools for a task, ranked by task fit × (price, health, latency) with the score breakdown. Free.
One tool: schemas, price, live health, permission level, examples, cheaper alternatives. Free.
Run a tool: L1 runs, L2 asks once (input_required), L3 returns an approval URL. Failures and empty results cost 0.

get.summary: The content-hashed catalog manifest.
Every listed endpoint: price, live health and p50/p95, categories, first-party label, permission level, data-handling statement, and the published score formula. Free, no key.
One listed endpoint with its description, exclusions, input/output JSON Schema and the score formula.
The open catalog as a server-rendered HTML page (no JavaScript).

post.summary: The router holds a run's price on the caller's wallet (E32): the caller's key in X-Caller-Authorization, the provider's price in the body; the gateway adds the take once (third-party only), applies caps and commits, and holds it as rcpt_run_<run_id> (idempotent). Not for agents.

parameters.name: X-Caller-Authorization
parameters.description: Bearer <the caller's agent key or OAuth token>, forwarded by the router; verified, never stored.

provider_micro_usd.description: The provider's price for a typical run, before the take (integer micro-USD; 1 USD = 1000000).

list_micro_usd.description: Provider price + one take (third-party) (integer micro-USD; 1 USD = 1000000).

charged_micro_usd.description: Held; discounted under a commit (integer micro-USD; 1 USD = 1000000).

post.summary: The router's outbox delivers its run settlements (content-free; idempotent by run_id): each settles its run's wallet hold once (provider price + one take for third-party runs, $0 for failures and empty results) and accrues the provider. Not for agents.

receipt_id.description: /2: rcpt_run_<run_id> when the run held money, else null

marketplace.description: /2: the marketplace an imported tool came from (monid), else null

provider_micro_usd.description: The provider's price; 0 unless ok (integer micro-USD; 1 USD = 1000000).

get.summary: The provider this key's principal owns: payout account status, this month's runs and earnings, the minimum payout.

parameters.name: provider_id
parameters.description: Required when the principal owns several providers.

post.summary: A Stripe Connect Express onboarding link for the provider's payout account. Hand the URL to a human at the provider once.

get.summary: Where Stripe returns the provider after onboarding (signed state). Binds payout_account_ref once payouts are enabled. HTML, no JavaScript. Not for agents.
A fresh onboarding link when Stripe's has expired (signed state) → 302. Not for agents.
The provider's monthly statement: runs and earnings per day (failures and empty results at $0), our take, refunds, disputes and the payout decision.

post.summary: Bind a listed provider to the principal whose keys act for it (after the listing PR is merged).
A refund (deducted) or a dispute (holds the provider's payout while open) against a provider. One per Idempotency-Key.
Resolve a provider dispute: provider_won (nothing deducted) or provider_lost (deducted). Once.
Run the monthly provider payout for a closed month. Idempotent per provider-month (Stripe Idempotency-Key payout:<provider>:<month>).

agentKey.description: An agent key from POST /v1/agents. Scopes: read, write, run, admin (admin implies all).

oauth.description: OAuth 2.1 for MCP clients (docs/api/oauth.md): authorization code with PKCE S256; the client_id is the URL of a Client ID Metadata Document; no dynamic registration. Access tokens (sat_…) act as the consenting key, with at most its scopes and never admin.

scopes.run: Run tools (metered; L3 waits for approval)

scimToken.description: An enterprise tenant's SCIM bearer (one per tenant, stored only as a SHA-256 hash; rotate with POST /v1/admin/tenants/{id}/scim-token).

tenantAdminSession.name: __Host-shogun_tenant_admin
tenantAdminSession.description: A tenant admin session from SSO (/sso/{tenant}/login): a signed cookie, HttpOnly, Secure, SameSite=Strict, 30 minutes.

McpMethod.name: Mcp-Method
McpMethod.description: The JSON-RPC method (MCP 2026-07-28 Streamable HTTP). Anything but tools/call is free protocol traffic.

McpName.name: Mcp-Name
McpName.description: The tool name for tools/call. Classified by pricing.ts into read / ingest / model_op / run.

McpQuantity.name: Mcp-Quantity
McpQuantity.description: Units in this call (events for memory.ingest).

McpDryRun.name: Mcp-Dry-Run
McpDryRun.description: Quote only: nothing reserved, nothing forwarded.

McpToolId.name: Mcp-Tool-Id
McpToolId.description: For router.run: the tool whose provider price the router looks up.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Repeat with the same key to get the same outcome without a second effect.

X-Usage-Cost-Micro-Usd.description: 0 when the upstream answered anything but 2xx: a failed call costs nothing.

Retry-After.description: Seconds. Honour it; do not spin.

message.description: Plain English: what to do next.

cost_micro_usd.description: What this call cost (integer micro-USD; 1 USD = 1000000).

amount_micro_usd.description: The amount the refused call needs (integer micro-USD; 1 USD = 1000000).

accepts.description: Ordered by preference. The x402 entry appears only where X402_ENABLED (docs/decisions/0002-x402.md).

oneOf.description: x402 PaymentRequirements: pay this call in USDC and resend it with X-PAYMENT. 1 atomic unit = 1 micro-USD.

balance_micro_usd.description: Spendable balance at the time of refusal (integer micro-USD; 1 USD = 1000000).

spent_micro_usd.description: Spent in the period (integer micro-USD; 1 USD = 1000000).

day_micro_usd.description: Per key per UTC day (integer micro-USD; 1 USD = 1000000).

month_micro_usd.description: Per key per UTC month (integer micro-USD; 1 USD = 1000000).

day_micro_usd.description: Per principal per UTC day (integer micro-USD; 1 USD = 1000000).

month_micro_usd.description: Per principal per UTC month (integer micro-USD; 1 USD = 1000000).

ref.description: Another key id or a developer id, credited as the referrer.

day_micro_usd.description: May only lower the key default (integer micro-USD; 1 USD = 1000000).

month_micro_usd.description: May only lower the key default (integer micro-USD; 1 USD = 1000000).

key.description: Shown once. Never paste it into a chat, a log or a file.

reserved_micro_usd.description: Held by in-flight calls (integer micro-USD; 1 USD = 1000000).

day_micro_usd.description: Omit to reset to the default (integer micro-USD; 1 USD = 1000000).

month_micro_usd.description: Omit to reset to the default (integer micro-USD; 1 USD = 1000000).

reserved_micro_usd.description: Held by in-flight calls (integer micro-USD; 1 USD = 1000000).

amount_micro_usd.description: Between topup.min_micro_usd and topup.max_micro_usd (integer micro-USD; 1 USD = 1000000).

url.description: Hand it to a human once.

provider_price_micro_usd.description: For router.run / actions.execute: the provider price from router.inspect (integer micro-USD; 1 USD = 1000000).

oneOf.description: Held while in flight (integer micro-USD; 1 USD = 1000000).

funding.description: How the call was paid: the wallet, an annual commit, or one x402 payment (only where X402_ENABLED).

task.description: What the receiving agent is asked to do.

from_agent.description: Your agent id; default the key's agent (agent:<key id>).

query.description: What to recall for the task; default task.

handoff.description: docs/api/handoff.schema.json: a strict subset of export v1.

message.description: An A2A message carrying the part.

Statement.description: shogunagent/statement/v1. Amounts are integer micro-USD; `hash` is sha256 over the canonical JSON (RFC 8785) of every other field.

commit_funded_micro_usd.description: Drawn from a commit (integer micro-USD; 1 USD = 1000000).

wallet_funded_micro_usd.description: Drawn from the wallet (integer micro-USD; 1 USD = 1000000).

overage_micro_usd.description: Drawn above the amount (integer micro-USD; 1 USD = 1000000).

enforced.description: Members cannot consent to OAuth clients by pasting a key.

items.description: PEM RSA certificate or public key

JsonRpc.description: A JSON-RPC 2.0 envelope. Relayed to the core untouched; the gateway never parses it.

budget_micro_usd.description: Exclude tools whose typical run costs more (integer micro-USD; 1 USD = 1000000).

RouterEnvelope.description: The common response (plan §7.2): result, usage, latency_ms, hints, next_action.
